Key constraints include strict alignment requirements on the offset and length parameters, ensuring that data is written to erase-aligned boundaries to maintain the integrity of the swap image. The code also enforces a specific loop structure that iterates through the source data in chunks, checking for successful program operations before proceeding to the next iteration.
